comment: Ten rows hold 3 output rules and 7 review guards (D17.5-D17.7, D17.14-D17.15).
The body-summary module is outside the compiler binary, so the build compiles the test.
Build from the worktree root. Run the focused binary from its build directory.
build: mkdir -p build/$(uname -s)/debug/summary-output-mutate && build/$(uname -s)/debug/fort -I src/fort -I test/fort/support test/fort/ownership_summary_outputs_test.ft -o build/$(uname -s)/debug/summary-output-mutate/ownership_summary_outputs_test

stages.name: the summary suites
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/$(uname -s)/debug/fort --std-dir build/$(uname -s)/debug/std --cc clang --target x86_64-linux-gnu -j 6 ownership_calls_ ownership_recursive ownership_indirect ownership_summary_

mutations.old: bool release = output && action == output_action.release_value && owner;
mutations.what: an indirect release cannot consume a selected caller owner

mutations.old: bool moving = output && action == output_action.move_value && owner;
mutations.what: an indirect move cannot transfer a selected caller owner

mutations.old:
bool store = selected->proved && (action == output_action.store_value ||
        action == output_action.aggregate_store) &&
        (scalar || (output && (span_element ? base_owner :
            (owner || fir.type_aggregate(selected->ty)))));
mutations.what: an indirect store cannot empty an owner or select aggregate output storage

mutations.old:
if (input_operand.kind != fir.operand_kind.ok_const &&
                (!direct(input_operand.place) || reference_use) &&
                !add_read(in, out, input_operand.place, block, gap, operand, stmt->loc,
                    stmt->exit_loc, stmt->stmt)) { return; }
mutations.new:
if (input_operand.kind != fir.operand_kind.ok_const &&
                !direct(input_operand.place) &&
                !add_read(in, out, input_operand.place, block, gap, operand, stmt->loc,
                    stmt->exit_loc, stmt->stmt)) { return; }
mutations.what: a direct reference operand of a scalar store has no temporal use
an aliased move checks its destination before it empties the source
a loaded scalar store does not use its current loaded pointer
a whole aggregate clear keeps covered child contents and borrows
a loaded scalar store reads its captured value instead of its current local
a root aggregate clear keeps a prior retained child relation
a strong root update counts a covered child region that it removes
